│                        │       │                   31dcd2fc98831 
│                        │       ├ Title           : glibc: glibc: Privilege escalation and arbitrary code
│                        │       │                   execution via TOCTOU race condition in dynamic loader 
│                        │       ├ Description     : A time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in
│                        │       │                   the dynamic loader (ld.so) of the GNU C Library (glibc)
│                        │       │                   versions 2.14 through 2.44 allows a local attacker to
│                        │       │                   escalate privileges. When expanding $ORIGIN in DT_RPATH
│                        │       │                   for setuid/setgid (AT_SECURE) programs, glibc validates
│                        │       │                   the lexically normalized search path against the trusted
│                        │       │                   directories but then opens the raw, un-normalized path. On
│                        │       │                    systems where the Linux fs.protected_hardlinks sysctl is
│                        │       │                   disabled, a local attacker who hard-links such a program
│                        │       │                   into an attacker-controlled directory and wins a race to
│                        │       │                   replace an intermediate path component with a symbolic
│                        │       │                   link can direct the loader outside the trusted directory,
│                        │       │                   causing it to load an attacker-controlled shared object
│                        │       │                   and execute arbitrary code with the elevated privileges of
│                        │       │                    the program.
│                        │       │                   
│                        │       │                   Exploitation requires an installed setuid or setgid binary
│                        │       │                    whose DT_RPATH uses $ORIGIN followed by ".." traversal
│                        │       │                   that normalizes into a trusted directory, and the ability
│                        │       │                   to hard-link that binary and win the race by swapping a
│                        │       │                   path component for a symbolic link. Major Linux-based OS
│                        │       │                   distributions ship with fs.protected_hardlinks enabled by
│                        │       │                   default and mitigate the vulnerability.

│                        │       ├ Title           : glibc: glibc: Local attacker can cause denial of service
│                        │       │                   and information disclosure via stack-based buffer
│                        │       │                   overflow. 
│                        │       ├ Description     : A stack-based buffer overflow in the dynamic loader
│                        │       │                   (ld.so) of the GNU C Library (glibc) versions 2.14 through
│                        │       │                    2.44 allows a local attacker to crash or corrupt the
│                        │       │                   memory of setuid/setgid (AT_SECURE) programs.
│                        │       │                   
│                        │       │                   When such a program's DT_RPATH or DT_RUNPATH begins with
│                        │       │                   $ORIGIN and is followed by NUL or '/' the loader both
│                        │       │                   reads past the end of the path buffer and writes past the
│                        │       │                   end of a stack-allocated internal buffer. The corrupted
│                        │       │                   loader stack can lead to a loader crash (denial of
│                        │       │                   service) and limited disclosure of process memory.

│                        │       │                   cb671b84da545 
│                        │       ├ Title           : glibc: glibc: Denial of Service via out-of-bounds read in
│                        │       │                   strncasecmp 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The strncasecmp function in the GNU C Library 2.24 and
│                        │       │                   later optimized for the Power8 architecture may read one
│                        │       │                   byte beyond the input size limit, which may crash a
│                        │       │                   program when that byte is not readable.
│                        │       │                   
│                        │       │                   This condition may happen when the input strings to the
│                        │       │                   strncasecmp function are attacker controlled in an
│                        │       │                   application and they match all the way up to the edge of
│                        │       │                   their page and the neighbouring page is either not mapped
│                        │       │                   or is not readable.

│                        │       ├ Title           : libdm: lvm2: libdm: Denial of Service via uncontrolled
│                        │       │                   recursion in config parser 
│                        │       ├ Description     : A flaw was found in libdm. A local attacker could craft a
│                        │       │                   malicious Logical Volume Manager (LVM) metadata
│                        │       │                   configuration with deeply nested structures. This could
│                        │       │                   lead to uncontrolled recursion in the libdm configuration
│                        │       │                   file parser, exhausting the stack and causing any LVM
│                        │       │                   command reading the metadata to crash. This vulnerability
│                        │       │                   results in a Denial of Service (DoS) for affected
│                        │       │                   systems.

│                        │       ├ Title           : libevent: Libevent: HTTP header smuggling allows

│                        │       ├ Description     : Libevent is an event notification library. Prior to 2.1.13
│                        │       │                    and 2.2.2-alpha, libevent processes chunked HTTP trailers
│                        │       │                    in http.c through evhttp_read_trailer and merges them
│                        │       │                   into request headers. The fix introduces
│                        │       │                   evhttp_parse_headers_impl_ and a temporary trailer header
│                        │       │                   list. An unauthenticated remote attacker can place
│                        │       │                   security-sensitive fields in trailers so that an upstream
│                        │       │                   proxy and the libevent application interpret different
│                        │       │                   effective headers, enabling header smuggling,
│                        │       │                   authorization bypass, proxy-header spoofing, or cache
│                        │       │                   poisoning. The fix parses trailers into a temporary header
│                        │       │                    list and discards them instead of merging them into
│                        │       │                   req->input_headers. This issue is fixed in versions 2.1.13
│                        │       │                    and 2.2.2-alpha.

│                        │       │                   expat_realloc

│                        │       │                   overflow vulnerability in expat_realloc() function on

│                        │       │                   Attackers supplying malicious XML to applications parsing
│                        │       │                   with vulnerable libexpat can cause heap buffer overflow,
│                        │       │                   memory corruption, or denial of service.

│                        │       ├ Title           : expat: expat: Denial of Service via improper memory
│                        │       │                   tracking in XML_ParserReset 
│                        │       ├ Description     : libexpat 2.7.2 through 2.9.0 contains a denial of service
│                        │       │                   vulnerability because XML_ParserReset zeroes the direct
│                        │       │                   byte count but never offsets tracked heap allocations.
│                        │       │                   Attackers can submit a large XML document so later
│                        │       │                   documents on the same reset parser fail with
│                        │       │                   XML_ERROR_NO_MEMORY until it is recreated.

│                        │       ├ Title           : expat: expat: Denial of Service via delayed entity
│                        │       │                   amplification detection 
│                        │       ├ Description     : libexpat through 2.9.0 contains a denial of service
│                        │       │                   vulnerability because billion laughs protection in
│                        │       │                   accountingDiffTolerated() in xmlparse.c detects entity
│                        │       │                   amplification too late. Attackers can supply a moderately
│                        │       │                   sized XML document with a large DTD and nested entity
│                        │       │                   expansions to consume tens of seconds of CPU per parse.

│                        │       │                   40caead3d2340 
│                        │       ├ Title           : expat: expat: Denial of Service via NULL pointer
│                        │       │                   dereference in external entity parsing 
│                        │       ├ Description     : libexpat through 2.9.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference
│                        │       │                    vulnerability in externalEntityInitProcessor2() in
│                        │       │                   lib/xmlparse.c that mishandles the XML_TOK_NONE token from
│                        │       │                    empty input. Attackers who control stream chunking can
│                        │       │                   force an empty non-final first parse on an external entity
│                        │       │                    subparser, causing a later parse to crash the
│                        │       │                   application.

│                        │       │                   d844993fd18b6 
│                        │       ├ Title           : expat: expat: Denial of Service via integer overflow
│                        │       │                   during XML attribute parsing 
│                        │       ├ Description     : libexpat through 2.9.0 contains a signed integer overflow
│                        │       │                   vulnerability in storeAtts() in lib/xmlparse.c that allows
│                        │       │                    attackers to trigger out-of-bounds writes via oversized
│                        │       │                   attribute counts. Attackers can supply a multi-gigabyte
│                        │       │                   document with a start tag carrying over 2^30 attributes to
│                        │       │                    overflow attIndex and nPrefixes, crashing applications or
│                        │       │                    corrupting heap memory.

│                        │       ├ Description     : libexpat through 2.10.0 contains an out-of-bounds read
│                        │       │                   vulnerability in unknown_toUtf8() and unknown_toUtf16() in
│                        │       │                    xmltok.c when handling application-registered unknown
│                        │       │                   encodings. Attackers can supply a document ending in a
│                        │       │                   truncated multibyte sequence so the convert callback reads
│                        │       │                    past the parse buffer, leaking adjacent memory or
│                        │       │                   crashing applications.

│                        │       │                    to character data and default handlers.

│                        │       │                   47a0194ef150d 
│                        │       ├ Title           : expat: expat: Information disclosure via heap buffer
│                        │       │                   over-read in XML_ParseBuffer 
│                        │       ├ Description     : libexpat before commit 13c5f63 contains a heap buffer
│                        │       │                   over-read vulnerability in xmlparse.c. XML_ParseBuffer
│                        │       │                   advances the parse buffer end with parser->m_bufferEnd +=
│                        │       │                   len using a caller-supplied length that is not validated
│                        │       │                   against the allocated buffer size, so repeated
│                        │       │                   XML_ParseBuffer calls move m_bufferEnd past the end of the
│                        │       │                    heap allocation and subsequent parsing reads out of
│                        │       │                   bounds. Reaching this path requires a parse buffer to
│                        │       │                   already be present; otherwise XML_ParseBuffer returns
│                        │       │                   XML_ERROR_NO_BUFFER. A buffer is present after a prior
│                        │       │                   call to XML_GetBuffer, either directly (the common case)
│                        │       │                   or indirectly through a prior XML_Parse call that
│                        │       │                   allocates the buffer internally. The over-read discloses
│                        │       │                   adjacent heap memory to the calling application,
│                        │       │                   recovering heap pointers, libc function pointers, and code
│                        │       │                    pointers sufficient to defeat ASLR and build further
│                        │       │                   exploitation primitives.

│                        │       ├ Title           : expat: Expat: XML Injection via Malformed UTF-16 Input 
│                        │       ├ Description     : Expat before 2.8.5 fails to validate that a high surrogate
│                        │       │                    in UTF-16 input is followed by a low surrogate, allowing
│                        │       │                   malformed UTF-16 sequences to be accepted. Attackers can
│                        │       │                   supply UTF-16 encoded XML containing lone high surrogates
│                        │       │                   that consume the following code unit, causing Expat to
│                        │       │                   pass unpaired surrogates to applications built with

│                        │       │                   actionable security vulnerability because of its "threat
│                        │       │                   model doesn't consider attacks only possible by modifying
│                        │       │                   anything within the trust boundary (private keys, trusted
│                        │       │                   certificate authorities and their issued certificates
│                        │       │                   including intermediate CAs, etc.)" policy.

│                        │       │                   c95af8659897d 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via malformed PAC in
│                        │       │                   S4U2Proxy requests 
│                        │       ├ Description     : MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer
│                        │       │                   dereference vulnerability in the KDC's
│                        │       │                   get_pac_princ_with_realm() that returns success while
│                        │       │                   leaving the client principal NULL on malformed names. A
│                        │       │                   malicious or compromised cross-realm trusted KDC can send
│                        │       │                   an S4U2Proxy request with a PAC carrying a malformed
│                        │       │                   client name to crash krb5kdc and deny authentication.

│                        │       │                   74bf8d57baa64 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via crafted forwarded
│                        │       │                   credentials 
│                        │       ├ Description     : MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL
│                        │       │                   pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in rd_cred.c that
│                        │       │                   allows authenticated Kerberos clients to crash services by
│                        │       │                    sending mismatched KRB-CRED arrays. Attackers can send
│                        │       │                   forwarded credentials with more tickets than ticket_info
│                        │       │                   entries through gss_accept_sec_context() to crash GSS-API
│                        │       │                   acceptor services, causing denial of service. 
│                        │       ├ Severity        : MEDIUM

│                        │       │                   b04d7ccecf537 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 GSS-RPC client memory leak on XID mismatch
│                        │       │                   retries 
│                        │       ├ Description     : clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5
│                        │       │                   (aka krb5) does not free the RPC reply verifier between
│                        │       │                   retries, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                   of service (memory leak in GSS-RPC client programs) by
│                        │       │                   injecting RPC replies with mismatched XIDs or by
│                        │       │                   triggering authentication retries.

│                        │       │                   8893da319216c 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS in
│                        │       │                   RPCSEC_GSS buffer decode failure 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The RPCSEC_GSS authentication routines in
│                        │       │                   lib/rpc/authgss_prot.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4
│                        │       │                   and later do not free partially decoded buffers on
│                        │       │                   failure, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                   of service (memory leak in kadmind) via crafted RPCSEC_GSS
│                        │       │                    messages.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory leak DoS in
│                        │       │                   xdr_krb5_tl_data() decode failure 
│                        │       ├ Description     : xdr_krb5_tl_data() in lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT
│                        │       │                   Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free partially decoded data
│                        │       │                    on failure, which allows remote authenticated users to
│                        │       │                   cause a denial of service (memory leak in kadmind) via
│                        │       │                   crafted RPC requests that trigger a decode failure.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated memory leak DoS in KDB
│                        │       │                   keytab key decryption error path 
│                        │       ├ Description     : krb5_ktkdb_get_entry() in lib/kdb/keytab.c in MIT Kerberos
│                        │       │                    5 (aka krb5) 1.2.8 and later does not free decrypted key
│                        │       │                   material when a post-decryption check fails, which allows
│                        │       │                   remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak
│                        │       │                    in the KDC or kadmind) via requests that repeatedly
│                        │       │                   trigger key decryption failures.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated DoS exploiting
│                        │       │                   dereference of null policy name pointers 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.3 and later do not reject a
│                        │       │                   NULL policy name decoded by xdr_nullstring(), which allows
│                        │       │                    remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (kadmind crash via NULL pointer dereference) by sending a
│                        │       │                   policy request with an empty policy name that reaches
│                        │       │                   authorization checks or logging code.

│                        │       │                   1fb04ddefc2e7 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory exhaustion DoS
│                        │       │                    via unbounded RPC XDR allocation 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not
│                        │       │                   enforce size limits on XDR-decoded data, which allows
│                        │       │                   remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (memory exhaustion or excessive CPU consumption in
│                        │       │                   kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger unbounded
│                        │       │                   memory allocations during XDR decoding.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via
│                        │       │                    GSS-RPC auth flavor switching 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5)
│                        │       │                   1.4 and later does not release the previous authentication
│                        │       │                    context when a client switches from an RPCSEC_GSS or
│                        │       │                   AUTH_GSSAPI flavor to a non-GSS flavor on the same TCP
│                        │       │                   connection. This allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                    of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by repeatedly
│                        │       │                   establishing and abandoning GSS authentication contexts.[

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via
│                        │       │                    AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT error paths 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free decoded arguments
│                        │       │                   on certain error paths, which allows remote attackers to
│                        │       │                   cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind)
│                        │       │                   via crafted AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests that trigger
│                        │       │                   authentication failures.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated CPU DoS via
│                        │       │                   AUTH_GSSAPI client states cleanup 
│                        │       ├ Description     : clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT
│                        │       │                   Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) restarts its scan from the head of
│                        │       │                   the client list after each removal, resulting in quadratic
│                        │       │                    CPU cost. Remote attackers can cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (CPU consumption in kadmind) by accumulating a large
│                        │       │                   number of AUTH_GSSAPI client entries.

│                        │       │                   a59171a7b2f01 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory exhaustion
│                        │       │                   via failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.2 and later allows remote
│                        │       │                   attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion
│                        │       │                   in kadmind) by sending repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT
│                        │       │                   requests. Each failed request allocates client state that
│                        │       │                   is only freed after a 15-minute expiration timeout,
│                        │       │                   allowing an attacker to accumulate memory faster than it
│                        │       │                   is reclaimed.

│                        │       │                   95cd3e0691d7d 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated CPU DoS via quadratic
│                        │       │                   ASN.1 SEQUENCE OF decoding 
│                        │       ├ Description     : decode_sequence_of() in lib/krb5/asn.1/asn1_encode.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.11 and later grows the decoded
│                        │       │                    element array one entry at a time, which allows remote
│                        │       │                   attackers to cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in
│                        │       │                    the KDC) by sending an unauthenticated AS-REQ or TGS-REQ
│                        │       │                   with a large number of elements in a SEQUENCE OF field
│                        │       │                   over TCP.

│                        │       │                   95768ea9d2693 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via malformed PAC in
│                        │       │                   S4U2Proxy requests 
│                        │       ├ Description     : MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer
│                        │       │                   dereference vulnerability in the KDC's
│                        │       │                   get_pac_princ_with_realm() that returns success while
│                        │       │                   leaving the client principal NULL on malformed names. A
│                        │       │                   malicious or compromised cross-realm trusted KDC can send
│                        │       │                   an S4U2Proxy request with a PAC carrying a malformed
│                        │       │                   client name to crash krb5kdc and deny authentication.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via crafted forwarded
│                        │       │                   credentials 
│                        │       ├ Description     : MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL
│                        │       │                   pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in rd_cred.c that
│                        │       │                   allows authenticated Kerberos clients to crash services by
│                        │       │                    sending mismatched KRB-CRED arrays. Attackers can send
│                        │       │                   forwarded credentials with more tickets than ticket_info
│                        │       │                   entries through gss_accept_sec_context() to crash GSS-API
│                        │       │                   acceptor services, causing denial of service.

│                        │       │                   21571bc2820b8 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 GSS-RPC client memory leak on XID mismatch
│                        │       │                   retries 
│                        │       ├ Description     : clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5
│                        │       │                   (aka krb5) does not free the RPC reply verifier between
│                        │       │                   retries, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                   of service (memory leak in GSS-RPC client programs) by
│                        │       │                   injecting RPC replies with mismatched XIDs or by
│                        │       │                   triggering authentication retries.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS in
│                        │       │                   RPCSEC_GSS buffer decode failure 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The RPCSEC_GSS authentication routines in
│                        │       │                   lib/rpc/authgss_prot.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4
│                        │       │                   and later do not free partially decoded buffers on
│                        │       │                   failure, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                   of service (memory leak in kadmind) via crafted RPCSEC_GSS
│                        │       │                    messages.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory leak DoS in
│                        │       │                   xdr_krb5_tl_data() decode failure 
│                        │       ├ Description     : xdr_krb5_tl_data() in lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT
│                        │       │                   Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free partially decoded data
│                        │       │                    on failure, which allows remote authenticated users to
│                        │       │                   cause a denial of service (memory leak in kadmind) via
│                        │       │                   crafted RPC requests that trigger a decode failure.

│                        │       │                   18531922cb923 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated memory leak DoS in KDB
│                        │       │                   keytab key decryption error path 
│                        │       ├ Description     : krb5_ktkdb_get_entry() in lib/kdb/keytab.c in MIT Kerberos
│                        │       │                    5 (aka krb5) 1.2.8 and later does not free decrypted key
│                        │       │                   material when a post-decryption check fails, which allows
│                        │       │                   remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak
│                        │       │                    in the KDC or kadmind) via requests that repeatedly
│                        │       │                   trigger key decryption failures.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated DoS exploiting
│                        │       │                   dereference of null policy name pointers 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.3 and later do not reject a
│                        │       │                   NULL policy name decoded by xdr_nullstring(), which allows
│                        │       │                    remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (kadmind crash via NULL pointer dereference) by sending a
│                        │       │                   policy request with an empty policy name that reaches
│                        │       │                   authorization checks or logging code.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory exhaustion DoS
│                        │       │                    via unbounded RPC XDR allocation 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not
│                        │       │                   enforce size limits on XDR-decoded data, which allows
│                        │       │                   remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (memory exhaustion or excessive CPU consumption in
│                        │       │                   kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger unbounded
│                        │       │                   memory allocations during XDR decoding.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via
│                        │       │                    GSS-RPC auth flavor switching 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5)
│                        │       │                   1.4 and later does not release the previous authentication
│                        │       │                    context when a client switches from an RPCSEC_GSS or
│                        │       │                   AUTH_GSSAPI flavor to a non-GSS flavor on the same TCP
│                        │       │                   connection. This allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                    of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by repeatedly
│                        │       │                   establishing and abandoning GSS authentication contexts.[

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via
│                        │       │                    AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT error paths 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free decoded arguments
│                        │       │                   on certain error paths, which allows remote attackers to
│                        │       │                   cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind)
│                        │       │                   via crafted AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests that trigger
│                        │       │                   authentication failures.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated CPU DoS via
│                        │       │                   AUTH_GSSAPI client states cleanup 
│                        │       ├ Description     : clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT
│                        │       │                   Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) restarts its scan from the head of
│                        │       │                   the client list after each removal, resulting in quadratic
│                        │       │                    CPU cost. Remote attackers can cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (CPU consumption in kadmind) by accumulating a large
│                        │       │                   number of AUTH_GSSAPI client entries. 
│                        │       ├ Severity        : MEDIUM

│                        │       │                   fb44863c6cb12 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory exhaustion
│                        │       │                   via failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.2 and later allows remote
│                        │       │                   attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion
│                        │       │                   in kadmind) by sending repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT
│                        │       │                   requests. Each failed request allocates client state that
│                        │       │                   is only freed after a 15-minute expiration timeout,
│                        │       │                   allowing an attacker to accumulate memory faster than it
│                        │       │                   is reclaimed. 
│                        │       ├ Severity        : MEDIUM

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated CPU DoS via quadratic
│                        │       │                   ASN.1 SEQUENCE OF decoding 
│                        │       ├ Description     : decode_sequence_of() in lib/krb5/asn.1/asn1_encode.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.11 and later grows the decoded
│                        │       │                    element array one entry at a time, which allows remote
│                        │       │                   attackers to cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in
│                        │       │                    the KDC) by sending an unauthenticated AS-REQ or TGS-REQ
│                        │       │                   with a large number of elements in a SEQUENCE OF field
│                        │       │                   over TCP.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via malformed PAC in
│                        │       │                   S4U2Proxy requests 
│                        │       ├ Description     : MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer
│                        │       │                   dereference vulnerability in the KDC's
│                        │       │                   get_pac_princ_with_realm() that returns success while
│                        │       │                   leaving the client principal NULL on malformed names. A
│                        │       │                   malicious or compromised cross-realm trusted KDC can send
│                        │       │                   an S4U2Proxy request with a PAC carrying a malformed
│                        │       │                   client name to crash krb5kdc and deny authentication.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via crafted forwarded
│                        │       │                   credentials 
│                        │       ├ Description     : MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL
│                        │       │                   pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in rd_cred.c that
│                        │       │                   allows authenticated Kerberos clients to crash services by
│                        │       │                    sending mismatched KRB-CRED arrays. Attackers can send
│                        │       │                   forwarded credentials with more tickets than ticket_info
│                        │       │                   entries through gss_accept_sec_context() to crash GSS-API
│                        │       │                   acceptor services, causing denial of service.

│                        │       │                   4ee33062cee69 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 GSS-RPC client memory leak on XID mismatch
│                        │       │                   retries 
│                        │       ├ Description     : clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5
│                        │       │                   (aka krb5) does not free the RPC reply verifier between
│                        │       │                   retries, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                   of service (memory leak in GSS-RPC client programs) by
│                        │       │                   injecting RPC replies with mismatched XIDs or by
│                        │       │                   triggering authentication retries.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS in
│                        │       │                   RPCSEC_GSS buffer decode failure 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The RPCSEC_GSS authentication routines in
│                        │       │                   lib/rpc/authgss_prot.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4
│                        │       │                   and later do not free partially decoded buffers on
│                        │       │                   failure, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                   of service (memory leak in kadmind) via crafted RPCSEC_GSS
│                        │       │                    messages.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory leak DoS in
│                        │       │                   xdr_krb5_tl_data() decode failure 
│                        │       ├ Description     : xdr_krb5_tl_data() in lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT
│                        │       │                   Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free partially decoded data
│                        │       │                    on failure, which allows remote authenticated users to
│                        │       │                   cause a denial of service (memory leak in kadmind) via
│                        │       │                   crafted RPC requests that trigger a decode failure.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated memory leak DoS in KDB
│                        │       │                   keytab key decryption error path 
│                        │       ├ Description     : krb5_ktkdb_get_entry() in lib/kdb/keytab.c in MIT Kerberos
│                        │       │                    5 (aka krb5) 1.2.8 and later does not free decrypted key
│                        │       │                   material when a post-decryption check fails, which allows
│                        │       │                   remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak
│                        │       │                    in the KDC or kadmind) via requests that repeatedly
│                        │       │                   trigger key decryption failures.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated DoS exploiting
│                        │       │                   dereference of null policy name pointers 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.3 and later do not reject a
│                        │       │                   NULL policy name decoded by xdr_nullstring(), which allows
│                        │       │                    remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (kadmind crash via NULL pointer dereference) by sending a
│                        │       │                   policy request with an empty policy name that reaches
│                        │       │                   authorization checks or logging code.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory exhaustion DoS
│                        │       │                    via unbounded RPC XDR allocation 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not
│                        │       │                   enforce size limits on XDR-decoded data, which allows
│                        │       │                   remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (memory exhaustion or excessive CPU consumption in
│                        │       │                   kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger unbounded
│                        │       │                   memory allocations during XDR decoding.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via
│                        │       │                    GSS-RPC auth flavor switching 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5)
│                        │       │                   1.4 and later does not release the previous authentication
│                        │       │                    context when a client switches from an RPCSEC_GSS or
│                        │       │                   AUTH_GSSAPI flavor to a non-GSS flavor on the same TCP
│                        │       │                   connection. This allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                    of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by repeatedly
│                        │       │                   establishing and abandoning GSS authentication contexts.[
│                        │       │                   m

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via
│                        │       │                    AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT error paths 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free decoded arguments
│                        │       │                   on certain error paths, which allows remote attackers to
│                        │       │                   cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind)
│                        │       │                   via crafted AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests that trigger
│                        │       │                   authentication failures.

│                        │       │                   b943dc65b08d3 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated CPU DoS via
│                        │       │                   AUTH_GSSAPI client states cleanup 
│                        │       ├ Description     : clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT
│                        │       │                   Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) restarts its scan from the head of
│                        │       │                   the client list after each removal, resulting in quadratic
│                        │       │                    CPU cost. Remote attackers can cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (CPU consumption in kadmind) by accumulating a large
│                        │       │                   number of AUTH_GSSAPI client entries.

│                        │       │                   aeb0aac619ebe 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory exhaustion
│                        │       │                   via failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.2 and later allows remote
│                        │       │                   attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion
│                        │       │                   in kadmind) by sending repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT
│                        │       │                   requests. Each failed request allocates client state that
│                        │       │                   is only freed after a 15-minute expiration timeout,
│                        │       │                   allowing an attacker to accumulate memory faster than it
│                        │       │                   is reclaimed. 
│                        │       ├ Severity        : MEDIUM

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated CPU DoS via quadratic
│                        │       │                   ASN.1 SEQUENCE OF decoding 
│                        │       ├ Description     : decode_sequence_of() in lib/krb5/asn.1/asn1_encode.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.11 and later grows the decoded
│                        │       │                    element array one entry at a time, which allows remote
│                        │       │                   attackers to cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in
│                        │       │                    the KDC) by sending an unauthenticated AS-REQ or TGS-REQ
│                        │       │                   with a large number of elements in a SEQUENCE OF field
│                        │       │                   over TCP.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via malformed PAC in
│                        │       │                   S4U2Proxy requests 
│                        │       ├ Description     : MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer
│                        │       │                   dereference vulnerability in the KDC's
│                        │       │                   get_pac_princ_with_realm() that returns success while
│                        │       │                   leaving the client principal NULL on malformed names. A
│                        │       │                   malicious or compromised cross-realm trusted KDC can send
│                        │       │                   an S4U2Proxy request with a PAC carrying a malformed
│                        │       │                   client name to crash krb5kdc and deny authentication.

│                        │       │                   beabcc20e7c51 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: krb5: Denial of Service via crafted forwarded
│                        │       │                   credentials 
│                        │       ├ Description     : MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL
│                        │       │                   pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in rd_cred.c that
│                        │       │                   allows authenticated Kerberos clients to crash services by
│                        │       │                    sending mismatched KRB-CRED arrays. Attackers can send
│                        │       │                   forwarded credentials with more tickets than ticket_info
│                        │       │                   entries through gss_accept_sec_context() to crash GSS-API
│                        │       │                   acceptor services, causing denial of service. 
│                        │       ├ Severity        : MEDIUM

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 GSS-RPC client memory leak on XID mismatch
│                        │       │                   retries 
│                        │       ├ Description     : clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5
│                        │       │                   (aka krb5) does not free the RPC reply verifier between
│                        │       │                   retries, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                   of service (memory leak in GSS-RPC client programs) by
│                        │       │                   injecting RPC replies with mismatched XIDs or by
│                        │       │                   triggering authentication retries.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS in
│                        │       │                   RPCSEC_GSS buffer decode failure 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The RPCSEC_GSS authentication routines in
│                        │       │                   lib/rpc/authgss_prot.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4
│                        │       │                   and later do not free partially decoded buffers on
│                        │       │                   failure, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                   of service (memory leak in kadmind) via crafted RPCSEC_GSS
│                        │       │                    messages.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory leak DoS in
│                        │       │                   xdr_krb5_tl_data() decode failure 
│                        │       ├ Description     : xdr_krb5_tl_data() in lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT
│                        │       │                   Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free partially decoded data
│                        │       │                    on failure, which allows remote authenticated users to
│                        │       │                   cause a denial of service (memory leak in kadmind) via
│                        │       │                   crafted RPC requests that trigger a decode failure.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated memory leak DoS in KDB
│                        │       │                   keytab key decryption error path 
│                        │       ├ Description     : krb5_ktkdb_get_entry() in lib/kdb/keytab.c in MIT Kerberos
│                        │       │                    5 (aka krb5) 1.2.8 and later does not free decrypted key
│                        │       │                   material when a post-decryption check fails, which allows
│                        │       │                   remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak
│                        │       │                    in the KDC or kadmind) via requests that repeatedly
│                        │       │                   trigger key decryption failures.

│                        │       │                   cabce2cfca804 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated DoS exploiting
│                        │       │                   dereference of null policy name pointers 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.3 and later do not reject a
│                        │       │                   NULL policy name decoded by xdr_nullstring(), which allows
│                        │       │                    remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (kadmind crash via NULL pointer dereference) by sending a
│                        │       │                   policy request with an empty policy name that reaches
│                        │       │                   authorization checks or logging code.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind authenticated memory exhaustion DoS
│                        │       │                    via unbounded RPC XDR allocation 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not
│                        │       │                   enforce size limits on XDR-decoded data, which allows
│                        │       │                   remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (memory exhaustion or excessive CPU consumption in
│                        │       │                   kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger unbounded
│                        │       │                   memory allocations during XDR decoding.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via
│                        │       │                    GSS-RPC auth flavor switching 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5)
│                        │       │                   1.4 and later does not release the previous authentication
│                        │       │                    context when a client switches from an RPCSEC_GSS or
│                        │       │                   AUTH_GSSAPI flavor to a non-GSS flavor on the same TCP
│                        │       │                   connection. This allows remote attackers to cause a denial
│                        │       │                    of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by repeatedly
│                        │       │                   establishing and abandoning GSS authentication contexts.[
│                        │       │                   m

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory leak DoS via
│                        │       │                    AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT error paths 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free decoded arguments
│                        │       │                   on certain error paths, which allows remote attackers to
│                        │       │                   cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind)
│                        │       │                   via crafted AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests that trigger
│                        │       │                   authentication failures.

│                        │       │                   7b724e8f49259 
│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated CPU DoS via
│                        │       │                   AUTH_GSSAPI client states cleanup 
│                        │       ├ Description     : clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT
│                        │       │                   Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) restarts its scan from the head of
│                        │       │                   the client list after each removal, resulting in quadratic
│                        │       │                    CPU cost. Remote attackers can cause a denial of service
│                        │       │                   (CPU consumption in kadmind) by accumulating a large
│                        │       │                   number of AUTH_GSSAPI client entries.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 kadmind unauthenticated memory exhaustion
│                        │       │                   via failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.2 and later allows remote
│                        │       │                   attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion
│                        │       │                   in kadmind) by sending repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT
│                        │       │                   requests. Each failed request allocates client state that
│                        │       │                   is only freed after a 15-minute expiration timeout,
│                        │       │                   allowing an attacker to accumulate memory faster than it
│                        │       │                   is reclaimed.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: MIT krb5 KDC unauthenticated CPU DoS via quadratic
│                        │       │                   ASN.1 SEQUENCE OF decoding 
│                        │       ├ Description     : decode_sequence_of() in lib/krb5/asn.1/asn1_encode.c in
│                        │       │                   MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.11 and later grows the decoded
│                        │       │                    element array one entry at a time, which allows remote
│                        │       │                   attackers to cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in
│                        │       │                    the KDC) by sending an unauthenticated AS-REQ or TGS-REQ
│                        │       │                   with a large number of elements in a SEQUENCE OF field
│                        │       │                   over TCP.

│                        │       ├ Title           : krb5: Alteration of authentication indicators in CAMMAC
│                        │       │                   container 
│                        │       ├ Description     : In MIT krb5 release 1.14 and later (since authentication
│                        │       │                   indicator support was added), an authenticated attacker

│                        │       │                   e90103720dba1 
│                        │       ├ Title           : OpenLDAP: OpenLDAP LMDB: Denial of Service and Information
│                        │       │                    Disclosure via Heap Buffer Underflow 
│                        │       ├ Description     : OpenLDAP Lightning Memory-Mapped Database (LMDB) versions
│                        │       │                   0.9.14 before 0.9.34, prior to commit 8e1fda8, contain a
│                        │       │                   heap buffer underflow in the readline() function of
│                        │       │                   mdb_load. When processing malformed input containing an
│                        │       │                   embedded NUL byte, an unsigned offset calculation can
│                        │       │                   underflow and cause an out-of-bounds read of one byte
│                        │       │                   before the allocated heap buffer. This can cause mdb_load
│                        │       │                   to crash, leading to a limited denial-of-service
│                        │       │                   condition. 
│                        │       ├ Severity        : MEDIUM

│                        │       ├ Title           : util-linux: util-linux: failed external mount helper still

│                        │       ├ Description     : util-linux versions through 2.41.5 and 2.42.2 fail to
│                        │       │                   check mount helper exit status before running post-mount
│                        │       │                   hooks, allowing unprivileged users to execute privileged
│                        │       │                   operations on pre-existing filesystems. Attackers can
│                        │       │                   exploit X-mount.idmap or X-mount.owner hooks to clone
│                        │       │                   filesystems with inherited suid bits or modify target
│                        │       │                   inode permissions after a helper fails, achieving
│                        │       │                   privilege escalation.

│                        │       │                   a7fd3c5f5c18b 
│                        │       ├ Title           : util-linux: util-linux: nsenter --join-cgroup leaks root
│                        │       │                   cgroup migration authority 
│                        │       ├ Description     : The nsenter --join-cgroup option opens the target
│                        │       │                   cgroup.procs file as root and leaves that file descriptor
│                        │       │                   open across later namespace and credential changes and
│                        │       │                   across execve(). Because the kernel checks later cgroup
│                        │       │                   migrations using the credentials from the original open, a
│                        │       │                    program run in an attacker-controlled target can inherit
│                        │       │                   root's ability to move host processes between cgroups.
│                        │       │                   After a privileged operator uses --join-cgroup against
│                        │       │                   that target, an unprivileged user can migrate and
│                        │       │                   terminate unrelated root processes.

│                        │       │                   4f0aef6399e95 
│                        │       ├ Title           : util-linux: util-linux: restricted bind mounts do not pin
│                        │       │                   the source, allowing X-mount.owner/group/mode
│                        │       │                   redirection 
│                        │       ├ Description     : A flaw was found in util-linux. Restricted bind mounts
│                        │       │                   take the source path from fstab but do not pin that source
│                        │       │                    before the privileged mount. A local unprivileged user
│                        │       │                   who can replace the authorized source or a writable
│                        │       │                   ancestor can redirect SUID mount(8) to bind another host
│                        │       │                   directory. If the fstab entry also sets X-mount.owner,
│                        │       │                   X-mount.group, or X-mount.mode, root then changes
│                        │       │                   ownership or mode on that redirected inode.

│                        │       │                   81d25157982da 
│                        │       ├ Title           : sandboxed-containers: kernel: systemd-gpt-auto-generator:
│                        │       │                   Guest Data Leakage in Confidential Computing (Sandboxed
│                        │       │                   Containers) 
│                        │       ├ Description     : A flaw was found in the interaction between
│                        │       │                   systemd-gpt-auto-generator and 
│                        │       │                   confidential computing guest VM images in OpenShift
│                        │       │                   Sandboxed Containers 
│                        │       │                   (confidential peer pods). systemd-gpt-auto-generator
│                        │       │                   automatically discovers 
│                        │       │                   and mounts GPT partitions by type GUID at boot with no
│                        │       │                   user confirmation. In 
│                        │       │                   the confidential computing threat model, where the
│                        │       │                   host/hypervisor is the 
│                        │       │                   adversary, a malicious host can inject partitions into the
│                        │       │                    guest's virtual 
│                        │       │                   disk. Most critically, injecting a swap partition causes
│                        │       │                   the guest kernel to 
│                        │       │                   page out TEE-encrypted memory to a host-controlled block
│                        │       │                   device, breaking the 
│                        │       │                   confidentiality guarantee of the hardware TEE (AMD
│                        │       │                   SEV-SNP, Intel TDX).
│                        │       │                   
│                        │       │                   The PodVM images use a GPT-partitioned disk with dm-verity
│                        │       │                    on the root 
│                        │       │                   partition. However, the roothash= kernel parameter only
│                        │       │                   disables root 
│                        │       │                   auto-discovery — non-root partitions (swap, /home, /var,
│                        │       │                   /srv, /var/tmp) are 
│                        │       │                   still auto-discovered and mounted. The generator is
│                        │       │                   shipped unmasked in the 
│                        │       │                   RHEL systemd-udev subpackage, and no kernel command line
│                        │       │                   parameter in the 
│                        │       │                   measured UKI addon disables it. Additionally, the PodVM
│                        │       │                   measurement script 
│                        │       │                   captures PCRs 3, 9, 11, and 12, but not PCR 5 (GPT
│                        │       │                   partition table), so 
│                        │       │                   partition table modifications are not detected by remote
│                        │       │                   attestation.

│                        │       ├ Title           : p11-kit: Stack exhaustion via unbounded recursion in RPC
│                        │       │                   attribute parsing 
│                        │       ├ Description     : A flaw was found in p11-kit. The RPC message attribute
│                        │       │                   parsing functions p11_rpc_message_get_attribute() and
│                        │       │                   p11_rpc_message_get_attribute_array_value() form a
│                        │       │                   mutually-recursive call chain with no recursion depth
│                        │       │                   limit when processing nested CKA_WRAP_TEMPLATE,
│                        │       │                   CKA_UNWRAP_TEMPLATE, and CKA_DERIVE_TEMPLATE attributes.
│                        │       │                   An unauthenticated attacker with local access to the
│                        │       │                   p11-kit RPC Unix domain socket can send a specially
│                        │       │                   crafted request with deeply nested template attributes,
│                        │       │                   causing stack exhaustion and crashing the p11-kit server
│                        │       │                   process and its dependent services.

│                        │       │                   b38ff2dfe2404 
│                        │       ├ Title           : p11-kit: Integer overflow in RPC attribute-array length
│                        │       │                   calculation can under-allocate nested attribute storage on
│                        │       │                    32 bit systems 
│                        │       ├ Description     : A flaw was found in p11-kit. A local attacker, or one with
│                        │       │                    equivalent access to a reachable RPC channel, could
│                        │       │                   exploit an integer overflow vulnerability. By sending
│                        │       │                   specially crafted messages, the attacker can cause the
│                        │       │                   system to miscalculate memory allocation for nested
│                        │       │                   attributes. This leads to a memory corruption issue,
│                        │       │                   specifically a heap out-of-bounds write, which can crash
│                        │       │                   the p11-kit RPC parsing process, resulting in a Denial of
│                        │       │                   Service (DoS). This vulnerability is only exploitable on
│                        │       │                   32 bit systems.

│                        │       │                   248c1f3189606 
│                        │       ├ Title           : sandboxed-containers: kernel: systemd-gpt-auto-generator:
│                        │       │                   Guest Data Leakage in Confidential Computing (Sandboxed
│                        │       │                   Containers) 
│                        │       ├ Description     : A flaw was found in the interaction between
│                        │       │                   systemd-gpt-auto-generator and 
│                        │       │                   confidential computing guest VM images in OpenShift
│                        │       │                   Sandboxed Containers 
│                        │       │                   (confidential peer pods). systemd-gpt-auto-generator
│                        │       │                   automatically discovers 
│                        │       │                   and mounts GPT partitions by type GUID at boot with no
│                        │       │                   user confirmation. In 
│                        │       │                   the confidential computing threat model, where the
│                        │       │                   host/hypervisor is the 
│                        │       │                   adversary, a malicious host can inject partitions into the
│                        │       │                    guest's virtual 
│                        │       │                   disk. Most critically, injecting a swap partition causes
│                        │       │                   the guest kernel to 
│                        │       │                   page out TEE-encrypted memory to a host-controlled block
│                        │       │                   device, breaking the 
│                        │       │                   confidentiality guarantee of the hardware TEE (AMD
│                        │       │                   SEV-SNP, Intel TDX).
│                        │       │                   
│                        │       │                   The PodVM images use a GPT-partitioned disk with dm-verity
│                        │       │                    on the root 
│                        │       │                   partition. However, the roothash= kernel parameter only
│                        │       │                   disables root 
│                        │       │                   auto-discovery — non-root partitions (swap, /home, /var,
│                        │       │                   /srv, /var/tmp) are 
│                        │       │                   still auto-discovered and mounted. The generator is
│                        │       │                   shipped unmasked in the 
│                        │       │                   RHEL systemd-udev subpackage, and no kernel command line
│                        │       │                   parameter in the 
│                        │       │                   measured UKI addon disables it. Additionally, the PodVM
│                        │       │                   measurement script 
│                        │       │                   captures PCRs 3, 9, 11, and 12, but not PCR 5 (GPT
│                        │       │                   partition table), so 
│                        │       │                   partition table modifications are not detected by remote
│                        │       │                   attestation.

│                        │       │                   5f8e742ec1b68 
│                        │       ├ Title           : pcre2: PCRE2: Out-of-bounds write allows arbitrary code
│                        │       │                   execution via crafted regular expressions 
│                        │       ├ Description     : PCRE2 before 10.48 allows a pcre2_dfa_match out-of-bounds
│                        │       │                   write because reuse of a cached workspace block, in a
│                        │       │                   recursive DFA matching workspace, lacks a size check (even
│                        │       │                    though a newly allocated block, for the same purpose,
│                        │       │                   does have a size check). This outcome requires an
│                        │       │                   attacker-controlled regular expression, or a recursive
│                        │       │                   pattern in conjunction with a small heap limit (this can
│                        │       │                   be set through the API).
